name: Pricing question
trigger: The prospect asks about the price, cost, fees, packages, contract terms or discounts of the AI Sales Employee (e.g. "بكام", "التكلفة كام", "how much does it cost").
content: {"steps":[{"type":"say","message":"التكلفة بتختلف حسب احتياج كل شركة، وفريق المبيعات بيجهّز عرض مخصوص بعد ما يفهم احتياجكم، فمش هقدر أقول رقم دلوقتي.","message_translations":{"en":{"value":"The cost depends on each company's needs, and our sales team prepares a tailored proposal once they understand yours, so I can't give a number right now."}}},{"type":"ask","instruction":"Ask in one short question whether they would like a short meeting with our sales team to prepare the pricing for them.
